title: Recovery and Renewal
definition: Recovery and renewal is the ongoing process of walking in truth, healing, repentance, restoration, and growth through the grace of God.
summary: Recovery is not merely returning to stability; it is learning to walk in newness of life through Christ. Renewal involves the mind, heart, habits, relationships, and hope.
christFocus: Christ renews broken people and teaches them to walk in new life by His grace and Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Recovery is not merely returning to stability; it is learning to walk in newness of life through Christ. Renewal involves the mind, heart, habits, relationships, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
